sources.summary: MIT研究人员团队在Nature发表论文，提出一个机器学习后处理层，通过从历史数据中学习现有预报模型的错误并修正其输出，将两周到六周范围的预报准确率翻倍。该模型在ECMWF的季节间预报竞赛中获第一名，首次在该时间范围内稳定超过气候学平均值，并显著改善洪水、寒潮等极端天气事件的预测；模型开源、低成本、可附加于任意预报模型，肯尼亚气象部门已接洽用于改进季风季预报。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: MIT等团队在Nature用机器学习模型纠正预报误差，使2至6周预测准确率翻倍并获国际竞赛第一，为2021 Texas致至少246人死亡的灾害争取预警时间。

en.summary: A team of MIT researchers published a paper in Nature proposing a machine learning post-processing layer that learns from historical data to correct the errors of existing forecasting models, doubling forecast accuracy in the two- to six-week range. The model won first place in ECMWF's subseasonal forecasting competition, becoming the first to consistently beat climatology at that lead time and significantly improving forecasts of extreme weather events such as floods and cold waves.
